~ WHY YOU WILL LOVE “FAMILY TIDES” ~
• Private heated pool with backyard tiki bar and outdoor half bath
• Stunning 4th-floor ocean views from multiple balconies
• Just a 3-minute walk (500 ft) to the beach access
• Beautiful 2023 full home remodel, including luxury bathrooms and kitchen
• Ideal layout for large families with 4 levels of living space
• Outdoor oasis with dining areas, umbrellas, outdoor shower, and pool lighting
• 4+ bicycles, 6 beach chairs and wagon available for guest use

~ THE SPACE ~
Welcome to “Family Tides,” a beautifully remodeled four-story coastal retreat designed for unforgettable family beach vacations along Scenic Highway 30A. This spacious home blends luxury finishes, thoughtful design, and resort-style outdoor living—just steps from the beach.

The outdoor backyard oasis is a true highlight, featuring a private heated pool, tiki bar with sink and prep space, two outdoor dining tables seating six each with umbrellas, an outdoor half bath (perfect for kids), and an outdoor shower to rinse off after beach days. This private setup makes poolside living effortless and enjoyable for all ages.
Inside, the first level offers a comfortable king guest suite with walk-in closet and wet bar—ideal for guests who prefer minimal stair use. The newly remodeled bathroom features a custom tile walk-in shower, quartz vanity, and updated fixtures.

The second level opens to a spacious open-concept living area with multiple seating zones, including two full couches, three accent chairs, and an additional sitting nook with bistro table. The living room includes a flat-screen TV with sound bar. A full guest bathroom on this level was fully renovated with a new tub, custom tile surround, and quartz vanity. The gourmet kitchen is a standout, featuring brand-new quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, two dishwashers, a dedicated ice maker, double sinks (including a wet bar sink), ceramic cooktop, built-in wall oven and microwave, and fully stocked cabinetry. The kitchen bar seats eight, and the dining table seats eight, positioned beside a bay window overlooking the pool deck. French doors lead to a balcony with stairs down to the pool area.

The third level features the luxurious primary king suite with private balcony. The spa-inspired master bathroom showcases an oversized 10-foot custom walk-in shower with handcrafted artisan tile to the ceiling, dual shower heads, niches, seating, and elegant pebble mosaic flooring. A dual-sink quartz vanity completes the space. Also on this level are a guest queen bedroom and a bunk room with two twin-over-twin bunk sets, each with pull-out twin trundles. These bedrooms share a fully remodeled bathroom with custom tile tub surround and quartz vanity. The laundry area is conveniently located on this level.

The fourth level, accessed by a classic spiral staircase, offers an ocean-view family room with wet bar kitchenette, mini fridge, sofa sleeper, and flat-screen TV. Floor-to-ceiling windows and French doors lead to a panoramic balcony with lounge chairs—perfect for sunrise coffee and sunset views. This level also includes a guest queen bedroom with balcony, sharing a Jack-and-Jill style remodeled bathroom with custom tile shower and quartz vanity.

* Pool & Amenity Details *
Private Pool, pool heating available for $30 per night
Outdoor Tiki Bar with Sink
Outdoor Half Bathroom & Shower Station

4+ owner bicycles available for guest use

* Special Attention Rules *
NO pets, smoking, parties or events
Must be 30+ to book, no college spring breakers, families only
Maximum 4 large or 5 small vehicles, no street parking

~ THE AREA ~
“Family Tides” is ideally located along Scenic Highway 30A, placing guests in the heart of South Walton's most iconic beach communities while still enjoying a relaxed, family-friendly setting. Just minutes away, Seagrove Beach offers laid-back coastal charm with easy beach access, local eateries, and scenic coastal dune lakes. A short bike ride brings you to Seaside, famous for its pastel cottages, walkable town center, boutique shopping, farmers markets, and outdoor movies at Central Square.

Travel east along 30A to experience the striking architecture and upscale dining of Alys Beach, followed by the European-inspired streets of Rosemary Beach, known for its cobblestone paths, boutique shops, coffee houses, wine bars, and vibrant community events. Each town offers its own personality, making it easy to explore a new vibe every day.

Guests are also close to The HUB, a popular family destination featuring restaurants, live music, outdoor movies, shopping, and casual hangout spaces—perfect for evenings after the beach. The Timpoochee Trail, a 19-mile paved walking and biking path, runs directly along 30A, connecting Dune Allen Beach to Inlet Beach and providing effortless access to beaches, dining, and local attractions without ever getting in the car.

From sugar-white sand beaches and emerald Gulf waters to rare coastal dune lakes, nature trails, art galleries, and world-class dining, this stretch of 30A offers something for every age and interest. Whether you're seeking quiet beach days, active outdoor adventures, or vibrant coastal towns, “Family Tides” puts you right in the center of it all.

reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 
Our stay at Family Tides was absolutely fantastic! The house is beautiful, spacious, and perfectly designed for large families. The recent remodel really shows, the kitchen and bathrooms are stunning, and the spa-like master shower was a favorite.

The outdoor area was just as impressive. The private pool, tiki bar, and large pool deck made it easy to spend entire afternoons outside relaxing and grilling while the kids swam. Having the outdoor shower and bathroom by the pool was incredibly convenient.

The location was ideal, just a short walk to the beach, which made going back and forth throughout the day easy. The house also had plenty of beach gear and bikes, which was a great bonus. We also loved the fourth-floor balcony views of the Gulf.

The home was extremely clean, well stocked, and had more than enough space for everyone in our group to spread out comfortably. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a relaxing beach getaway on 30A!
